title: 🏛️ Exam 2025 · writing prepared: a shopping day at the mall ⭐⭐⭐

questions.prompt: (Exam 2025) Task: "Last week was the end of the spring season. All the shops at the mall gave a special offer. You went to the mall with your family for shopping. Write a paragraph (5 to 7 sentences) to talk about the shops you visited and what you bought there." What must the paragraph tell?

options.text: The shops that I would like to visit at the mall with my family next week.
The shops I visited at the mall and the things I bought there.
The special offers that my family sells at the mall.
The clothes that I wear when I go shopping every Saturday.

questions.explanation: The task asks for the shops that the writer visited and what was bought there, so the paragraph looks back at last week. A visit planned for next week, a family that sells goods, and the clothes worn on every Saturday are not what the task asks for.

questions.prompt: (Exam 2025) The paragraph tells what happened last week, so Sami writes in the simple past. Which sentence is correct?

options.text: Last week, my mother finded a silver ring.
Last week, my mother found a silver ring.
Last week, my mother finds a silver ring.
Last week, my mother will find a silver ring.

questions.explanation: Last week is over, so the verb goes into the simple past, and find is irregular: it has its own past form and never takes -ed. The form with -ed adds the regular ending to a verb that refuses it, the form with -s is the present, and the form with will is the future.

questions.prompt: (Exam 2025) Sami writes what his family bought at the mall. Match each shop with the thing that was bought there.

options.text: the bakery
the butcher's
the jewellery shop
the music shop
a silver necklace for my aunt
two croissants for breakfast
a guitar for my brother
a kilo of meat for lunch

questions.explanation: The bakery sells the croissants, the butcher's sells the meat, the jewellery shop sells the silver necklace, and the music shop sells the guitar: each shop is named after the goods it sells.

questions.prompt: (Exam 2025) Sami has told which shops he visited. Which sentence can he add about what he bought?

options.text: My little sister goes to school by bus every morning.
The mall is open every day of the week.
I bought a red sweater for only forty dinars.
In winter, the weather is cold and rainy here.

questions.explanation: A sentence of the paragraph must tell what Sami bought in the shops. The way his sister goes to school, the opening days of the mall and the winter weather may be true, but they say nothing about his purchases.

questions.prompt: (Exam 2025) The task says: "All the shops at the mall gave a special offer." What is true when a shop gives a special offer?

options.text: The prices go up for a few days.
The shop is closed for a few days.
The prices go down for a few days.
The shop gives all its goods to the customers.

questions.explanation: A special offer is a price for a few days only, and the price goes down: the customer pays less. Prices going up is the opposite, a closed shop sells nothing, and no shop gives all its goods away.

questions.prompt: (Exam 2025) Sami writes about his Saturday at the mall. Which of these sentences are correct?

options.text: We went to the jewellery shop first.
My father buyed a guitar for my brother.
My mother bought a silver ring there.
We goed to the toy shop after that.
I try on a blazer last Saturday.
My sister chose a red sweater.

questions.explanation: Went, bought and chose are the irregular past forms of go, buy and choose, so the three sentences with them are correct. Buyed and goed add -ed to verbs that refuse it, and try on is a present form, which cannot go with last Saturday.

questions.prompt: (Exam 2025) Put these sentences in the order of a clear paragraph about a day at the mall.

options.text: After that, my mother chose a silver necklace at the jewellery shop.
Last Saturday, we all spent the day at the mall.
At the end of the day, we were tired but happy.
Then, my father tried on a blazer in the clothes shop.
First, we visited the toy shop and my sister paid for a doll.

questions.explanation: The paragraph opens with the situation (Last Saturday, we all spent the day at the mall). The visits then follow the order of the time words First, Then and After that, and the paragraph closes with the end of the day.

questions.prompt: (Exam 2025) At the end of the day, Sami adds up the money. Which sentence is correct?

options.text: We spented three hundred and sixty dinars at the mall.
We spend three hundred and sixty dinars at the mall last Saturday.
We spent three hundred and sixty dinars at the mall.
We spent three hundreds and sixty dinars at the mall.

questions.explanation: Last Saturday is over, so the verb goes into the simple past, and spend is irregular: it becomes spent. Hundred takes no -s after a number, and the hundreds are joined to the rest of the number by and: three hundred and sixty. The form with -ed adds the regular ending to a verb that refuses it, and the present form clashes with last Saturday.
